question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **with**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition** "with" **is used to indicate association, connection, or inclusion. (के साथ)

 
 
• **Example: **He works with his father in the family business.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that Democracy is a system of governance in which the people hold the ultimate power.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'with'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **with**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **towards** (की ओर): In the direction of.

 
 
• **Example:** She walked towards the park.
 
 
 
• **on** (पर): Physically in contact with and supported by a surface.
 
 
• **Example: **The book is on the table.
 
 
 
• **by** (द्वारा): Identifying the agent performing an action.
 
 
• **Example:** The song was sung by the famous artist.
